contexts.text: That which is future, or that which is present is the same with the Lord, and therefore in the angelic Heaven. That which is future is present, or that which will come to pass, has come to pass. Hence came the representation of the temptations...
Everyone ought to provide for himself the necessaries of life... not only for the present time, but also for the future.
(The Angels) said that things to come they know not, because to know things to come belongs to the Lord alone...
A signification of the future in respect to the interior and more interior doctrine of man. Explained.
A signification of the future. Explained.

The Angels do not know future things: the Lord alone knows them, and he to whom He deigns to reveal them. I before perceived something to be as it were detested when some desired to know future things... but in the last times... future things are not foretold... One reason only may be adduced. The Angels, in order to be in happiness, must not know the least of what is future; for the Lord provides for them what they should think every instant. So the Lord has said, that they be not solicitous about the future. Besides, the Knowledge of the future, which Spirits are very eager for, would involve very many things that would disturb them...
Nor are they able or willing to acknowledge... that man should not be solicitous about future things.
There are various objects of the thoughts, which, while a man is kept in them... by Spirits, create much harm; as... concerning those things... which are future...
As to what is eternal (the Angels) have no idea of past and future things, but both past and future things are in their present.
